info.title: Colivo
info.description: Colivo REST API: meals, groceries, rent and bills for shared homes.

get.description: Report whether the backend can reach the database and Redis.

post.description: Send a one-time code by SMS or email; the same answer for any contact.
Create a home; the person signing up becomes its owner and is logged in.

Log in with a phone or email and its one-time code.

The answer lists the person's homes; ``me`` is set only for one home.
End the session and clear its cookie; needs no home (Phase 1b).

get.description: Who is logged in, and in which home; renews the cookie for 30 days.

patch.description: Fix your own name; this also finishes the first log-in check.

get.description: The logged-in person's active homes, to choose one; needs no home.

schema.title: Response My Homes Api V1 Me Homes Get

get.description: Everyone in the home, for the owner and managers.

schema.title: Response List Members Api V1 Members Get

post.description: Add a member to the home; they get an SMS or email to log in.

patch.description: Change a member's name or join date.

put.description: Give or take away the Manager role; the owner only.

post.description: Deactivate a member from a date; they can't log in from then on.
Reactivate a member from the date charges start again.

get.description: The setup checklist of the logged-in owner's or manager's home.

The answer to a log-in: the person's homes, and ``me`` for one home.

With several homes, ``me`` is None and the client asks which home.
